title: Sbek Thom Siem Reap: Khmer Shadow Puppet Art Guide
description: Experience Sbek Thom, the UNESCO-listed Cambodian shadow theatre in Siem Reap. Sacred leather carving and evening firelit performances for golf travelers.
content:
> **Executive Summary:**
>
> *   Sbek Thom, a UNESCO-designated, pre-Angkorian shadow puppetry art form, involves meticulously carved cowhide puppets depicting Reamker episodes, traditionally performed to invoke gods.
> *   The 2-hour experience near Siem Reap includes meeting a master carver, an optional leather carving session, and a private performance with a Pinpeat orchestra.
> *   Asia Golf Specialists (AGS) offers priority reservations, skip-the-line access, and luxury SUV transfers for this year-round, advance-booking-required experience.
>
> *Related: Explore our [Premium Southeast Asia Tours](/tours/) luxury itinerary.*

## The AGS Executive Summary
Engage with the ancient, UNESCO-designated art of Sbek Thom—large-scale shadow puppetry utilizing meticulously carved leather, performed entirely behind a fire-lit screen.

## The Operator & Origin Story
Sbek Thom is a sacred art form that predates the Angkor period, traditionally performed only on specific occasions to invoke the gods. The massive leather puppets, intricately carved from cowhide, depict episodes from the Reamker (the Khmer version of the Ramayana).

## The Itinerary & Deep Dive
Visit a specialized artisan workshop near Siem Reap. You will meet a master carver who explains the intensive spiritual and physical process of creating the giant leather puppets. 

You can optionally participate in a leather carving session. You are then treated to a private, short performance demonstrating the complex choreography required to manipulate the heavy puppets behind a glowing white screen, accompanied by a traditional Pinpeat orchestra.

## Experience Data
| Metric | Details |
|---|---|
| **Vibe / Atmosphere** | Artisanal, Traditional, Educational |
| **Duration** | 2 Hours |
| **Physical Demand** | None |
| **Best Paired With** | A quiet, immersive afternoon activity. |

## An Intimate Post-Round Cultural Immersion in Siem Reap
Unlike half-day temple hikes that demand hours on your feet, **Sbek Thom: Khmer Shadow Puppet Masterclass** is a serene, two-hour seated workshop and performance held in a leafy Siem Reap artisan compound just 15 minutes from [Angkor Golf Resort](/courses/cambodia/angkor-golf-resort/) and 10 minutes from [Amansara](/accommodations/cambodia/amansara/), [Raffles Grand Hotel d'Angkor](/accommodations/cambodia/raffles-grand-dangkor/), and [Jaya House River Park](/accommodations/cambodia/jaya-house-river-park/). After your group completes 18 holes on Sir Nick Faldo’s [Angkor Golf Resort](/courses/cambodia/angkor-golf-resort/) or tests the water-lined fairways of [Phokeethra Country Club](/courses/cambodia/phokeethra/), a 4:00 PM private studio visit offers a restorative cultural bridge before evening dining.

Recognized by UNESCO as an Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity, *Sbek Thom* predates the stone reliefs of Angkor Wat itself, using towering perforated cowhide panels held aloft by dancers silhouetted against a flickering coconut-husk fire screen.

## Private Studio Carving & Torchlight Pinpeat Performance
* **Hands-On Hide Chiseling:** Under the guidance of a master leather carver, guests inspect cured cowhide templates depicting Hanuman, Rama, and Ravana from the *Reamker* epic, trying their hand at traditional bamboo-mallet chiseling—with custom-carved miniature leather bookmarks or bag tags available as bespoke golf-group keepsakes.
* **Private Courtyard Fire Performance:** As dusk settles, a live *Pinpeat* ensemble of xylophones (*roneat*), gongs, and oboes accompanies two narrators and puppet dancers behind a white cotton screen illuminated by burning coconut shells, followed by chilled champagne or craft beer in the courtyard.

## Connecting Sbek Thom Artistry With Siem Reap’s Temple & Golf Heritage
Studying the perforated leather narratives of the *Reamker* before or after your private dawn scholar walk at [Angkor Wat](/destinations/cambodia/cambodia-culture-angkor-wat-sunrise-scholar/) brings the 12th-century sandstone bas-reliefs to life, while giving golfers on [Cambodia Angkor Odyssey](/tours/cambodia-angkor-odyssey/) a relaxed afternoon cultural interlude between championship rounds at [Angkor Golf Resort](/courses/cambodia/angkor-golf-resort/) and [Phokeethra Country Club](/courses/cambodia/phokeethra/). Private door-to-door transfers from [Raffles Grand Hotel d'Angkor](/accommodations/cambodia/raffles-grand-dangkor/), [Amansara](/accommodations/cambodia/amansara/), [Zannier Hotels Phum Baitang](/accommodations/cambodia/zannier-phum-baitang/), and [Jaya House River Park](/accommodations/cambodia/jaya-house-river-park/) ensure your group moves effortlessly from the artisan courtyard to a 7:00 PM tasting menu at [Cuisine Wat Damnak](/destinations/cambodia/cambodia-culinary-cuisine-wat-damnak/).

faqs.q: Can the Sbek Thom Shadow Puppet Masterclass be done after a morning round of golf in Siem Reap?
faqs.a: Yes. Because the 2-hour studio visit and performance is entirely seated and takes place at 4:00 PM or 5:00 PM, it pairs effortlessly after a morning round at Angkor Golf Resort or Phokeethra Country Club.

faqs.q: Where does the Sbek Thom workshop take place relative to Siem Reap's luxury hotels?
faqs.a: The master carver's studio and outdoor performance courtyard sit in Siem Reap's cultural district, roughly 10 to 12 minutes by private SUV from Raffles Grand Hotel d'Angkor, Amansara, and Zannier Hotels Phum Baitang.

faqs.q: Can we commission custom-carved Khmer leather keepsakes for our golf tournament group?
faqs.a: Yes. With 30 days' advance notice, Asia Golf Specialists can commission the master carvers to hand-chisel bespoke cowhide commemorative plaques or bag tags for your invitational flight.
